t: Memo No. 28 - Re Voong Nyui Ding And Tai Tuh Hyuin

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. C. D....118....
Date......6.4.29....

April 5, 29

Sir,

In reply to your letter of March 10 I have
the honour to inform you that careful enquiries
have failed to locate Georgi Stepanovich
Franchishin in Shanghai.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Director of Criminal Investigation.

The Chief of Police,
Harbin.
------------
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处档案室
编号 I. C. D....118....
日期......29年4月6日....

1929年4月5日

先生：

复您3月10日来信，谨此奉告，经仔细查访，未能在上海找到 Georgi Stepanovich Franchishin（音译）。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，

刑事侦缉处处长

哈尔滨警察局局长
------------
